children: Crude oil fell below $93 per barrel on Tuesday, ending a three-session winning streak as investors weighed the impact of Russian diesel exports against escalating geopolitical tensions.
Russia partially lifted its diesel export restrictions on October 10 following an agreement with the US, helping ease supply constraints in global fuel markets.

However, US lawmakers argued that President Trump’s agreement with Russian President Vladimir Putin appeared to violate US law prohibiting Russian energy imports until Moscow ends its aggression against Ukraine.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy also vowed to continue strikes against Russia as Moscow persists in targeting Ukraine’s energy infrastructure, breaching the “energy ceasefire” previously announced by Trump.

Meanwhile, the Trump administration faces mounting pressure to support Saudi Arabia in its fight against Iran-backed Houthi militants in Yemen following missile and drone attacks on Riyadh’s main airport.

title: Oil Retreats After Three-Day Rally
